ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem statement: the solution set of the inequality ax-b<0 is (1,+∞), and it is required to find the solution set of the inequality (ax+b)(x-3)>0. First analyze the linear inequality ax-b<0: if a>0, then ax<b, and the solution is x<b/a; if a<0, then when dividing by a negative number the inequality sign reverses, and the solution is x>b/a. The known solution set is x>1, so it must be that a<0, and b/a=1, therefore b=a. Thus ax+b=ax+a=a(x+1). Substituting into the target inequality gives a(x+1)(x-3)>0. Because a<0, after dividing both sides by the negative number a, the inequality sign reverses, obtaining (x+1)(x-3)<0. The two zeros of this product are x=-1 and x=3, and when the product of the quadratic factors is less than 0, x is between the two roots, so the solution set is (-1,3).

method.method_draft: 从题面读取：不等式 ax-b<0 的解集为 (1,+∞)，目标是不等式 (ax+b)(x-3)>0 的解集。先把 ax-b<0 看作一次不等式：若 a<0，则解集为 x>b/a；若 a>0，则解集为 x<b/a。已知解集是 x>1，所以必须有 a<0 且 b/a=1，即 b=a。于是 ax+b=ax+a=a(x+1)。代入目标不等式得 a(x+1)(x-3)>0。因为 a<0，除以负数后不等号反向，得到 (x+1)(x-3)<0。两根为 -1 和 3，二次因式乘积小于 0 时在两根之间，因此解集为 (-1,3)。
